inputs.text: Larry Rhoden signed Senate Bill 175 on Thursday, and the “only state elections” and “only new registrants” wording looks designed to make the change seem harmless. That’s how they get people used to new barriers: start with a supposedly limited group, then treat the precedent as normal. The narrow framing is no reassurance—it’s part of the pitch.
